expected_findings.note: Express applies router.use middleware only to routes registered after it. reset-password is registered above requireAdmin and its own check was removed, so any logged-in user can reset any user's password.

risk_checks.title: Admin check removed from deleteUser
risk_checks.detail: deleteUser no longer verifies that the caller is an admin before deleting an account.

risk_checks.title: Admin check removed from resetPassword
risk_checks.detail: resetPassword no longer verifies that the caller is an admin before resetting a password.
